scenarios.description: Qualify typed read-only Time consumers through the public gateway.

requirements.explanation: Requires VEOVEO_TIME_CONSUMERS_INPUT, an installation target, private caller and administrator token files, selected authority/calendar/epoch/source fixtures and a new receipt path. Reads Time through the public gateway; performs no Task, restart or authority activation.

scenarios.description: Qualify selected schedule Task creation, delivered Completed state and independent typed result through the public gateway.

requirements.explanation: Requires VEOVEO_TIME_SCHEDULE_TASK_INPUT, a public Gateway endpoint/profile with official Time Tasks, a private OAuth caller token file, stable selected current authority/calendar, independent expected schedule output and new private JSONL receipt. Creates one deterministic schedule Task and uses maintained lifecycle cleanup. Performs no Deployment restart or authority activation; cancellation and unfinished recovery remain unqualified.
